frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Miller's static and Harrison-Kreps / Scheinkman-Xiong dynamic mechanisms: when investors disagree (driven by overconfidence) and short sales are constrained, prices reflect only optimists, producing overvaluation; the dynamic resale option also generates speculative bubbles and very high trading volume.
